name: ml-corporate-income-tax
description: Mali corporate income tax research draft for 2026, using an explicitly older DGI statutory baseline whose later amendment chain remains unproved. Use it to prepare a conditional company profit-tax workpaper, distinguish companies from transparent businesses, reconcile accounting profit and deductions, compare ordinary profit tax with the turnover minimum, identify instalments and reconstruct the source filing timetable. It also preserves the former Guide's dividend, interest and non-resident-payment topics with instrument and base distinctions. Mining conventions, treaty relief, current forms and portal boxes need separate verification. Two executable cases test the source arithmetic only. No accountant has attested to this version and no operative 2026 coverage is claimed.
